full_exploration_result: All four runs reached 100% correct free coverage. S_T16 is worse than G_T16 on left-layout coverage completion and global surface F1; right layout is tied. No semantic exploration-efficiency advantage established.
validated_narrow_result: Independent structure-probability calibration improves neutral test NLL and reduces high-confidence errors; neutral classification accuracy is unchanged. Semantic cues can alter native candidates and actual outcomes with object/global surface tradeoffs.
interval_result: Widened diagnostic intervals not promoted; held-out object coverage 21/24, mean width 2.316 m, interval score worsened.
conditions: Synthetic exact poses and noiseless opaque RGB-D with ideal acquired instance/category cues; two complete-exploration layouts share one floorplan. No natural detector, physical reconstruction accuracy, real-time performance, or cross-scene superiority claim.
